answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to post a refundable stake that is slashed on proven misbehavior, so creating thousands of fake agents means locking real capital for each one. Like a wanderer who must carry a lantern through a long toll road, an attacker pays per identity, and the cost grows linearly while honest agents reuse one verified lotus credential across services. Forged identities therefore cannot outbid genuine reputation cheaply.
